about: Travelers' questions for the support chat, asked by chat/scripts/ask.py. Each names the Lean model's answer for people reading the report; 'policy' says whether the Automated Reasoning policy decides it ('covered') or not ('beyond', which probes what a check does with an answer the policy cannot judge).

questions.question: I'm on a Basic ticket and my plans changed. Can I move my flight to next week if I pay a fee?
questions.lean: No: the Basic fare allows no change at any stage (BASIC-CHANGE-PAID).

questions.question: What does it cost to change a Main fare after I've already flown the first leg?
questions.lean: A $75 change fee plus any difference in fare (MAIN-CHANGE-FLOWN).

questions.question: I missed my Main flight this morning. Can I rebook onto the next flight?
questions.lean: No: a Main fare cannot be changed after a missed flight (MAIN-CHANGE-MISSED).

questions.question: I missed my Flex flight. Can I change to a later one, and is there a fee?
questions.lean: Yes, with no change fee; only any difference in fare (FLEX-CHANGE-MISSED).

questions.question: If I cancel my Main booking before the trip starts, how much do I get back?
I flew out on my Main ticket but want to cancel the rest of the trip. What do I get back?
I missed my flight on a Main fare. If I cancel the rest, do I get anything back?
I booked Flex and want to cancel before departure. Do I get all my money back?
I was a no-show on my Flex flight. What do I get back if I cancel now?
Can I get any refund on a Basic fare if I cancel before departure?
I paid $320 for Main and the new flight I want costs $380. What's the total to change before departure?
questions.lean: $135: the $60 difference in fare plus the $75 fee (ONE-202, MAIN-CHANGE-PAID).

questions.question: I paid $520 for Flex and want to switch to a $600 flight before departure. What do I pay?
questions.lean: $80: the difference in fare, with no change fee (ONE-202, FLEX-CHANGE-PAID).

questions.question: Is there ever a change fee on the Flex fare?
questions.lean: No: a Flex change has no fee at any stage (FLEX-CHANGE-PAID, -FLOWN, -MISSED).

questions.question: My Main fare cost $320 and I'm changing to a cheaper $300 flight before departure. What do I pay or get back?
questions.lean: The model nets the $20 lower fare against the $75 fee, but how an excess penalty is handled is a reading the model leaves open (ONE-202.4).

questions.question: Can I cancel a booking I haven't paid for yet, and will I owe anything?
questions.lean: Yes, at any time, and there is nothing to pay (ONE-203).

questions.question: I paid $100 and already got a $60 refund. Can I get another $60 refund on the same payment?
questions.lean: Each refund alone is within the payment, so the model accepts it; whether refunds are capped in total is still open (OO-003.2).

questions.question: Which fare should I buy if I might need to cancel before I fly?
questions.lean: Flex returns the full price, Main returns $150, Basic returns nothing (the cancel terms before departure).

questions.question: Verified Airline cancelled my Basic flight. Do I get a refund?
questions.lean: Still being decided: how much of the fare comes back when the airline cancels a flight and cannot move the traveler; the page asks the traveler to contact the airline (schedule changes).
